final_draft.note: I couldn't find an approved answer or policy text about ISO 27001 certification or a certificate number. I ran two searches ("ISO 27001 certification certificate number" and "information security certifications audits SOC 2 ISO"). They only returned unrelated entries: the Access Control Policy section on authentication, plus approved answers on penetration testing and encryption in transit. Nothing says whether the company holds ISO 27001 certification, so I haven't drafted an answer either way. The certificate number needs to come from the security owner (security@harborlight.example). If the company is certified, an approved answer should be added that includes the certificate number, the certification body, the scope and the expiry date.
